description: Puntos Limpios - Ubicación is a dataset listed in Chilean national open data portal (datos.gob.cl), an open data portal, published or maintained by Municipalidad de La Reina. Ubicación de puntos limpios de reciclaje de la comuna de La Reina, con descripción de elementos reciclables. Coverage: Municipalidad de La Reina. The portal files it under the publisher Municipalidad de La Reina. Its tags are Medio Ambiente, Reciclaje. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2017-09-08 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-cl-portal.
